items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: I was the first trombone player at Joe Robichaux High.

ctx.x: And, well he's really, a fella really encouraged me to play trombone. Well then he went out on the road with Joe Robichaud, well then I went to Lesson, I pinched back two real a while.
Whatever happened to him, I never did know him.
